TPMP_SOV_dy_deliver = {
	TPMP_SOV_dy_display = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_t_lt36 = 1 } check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_n_lt36 > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = light_tank_chassis_1936 amount = TPMP_SOV_dy_n_lt36 producer = SOV }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_t_lt38 = 1 } check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_n_lt38 > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = light_tank_chassis_1938 amount = TPMP_SOV_dy_n_lt38 producer = SOV }
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_t_mt36 = 1 } check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_n_mt36 > 0 } }

		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment_0 amount = TPMP_SOV_dy_n_art producer = SOV }
	}
	if = {

		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment_0 amount = TPMP_SOV_dy_n_mot producer = SOV }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_fb_n > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = line_infantry_equipment_1 amount = TPMP_SOV_dy_fb_n producer = SOV }
	}
	set_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_dy_delivered
	clr_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_dy_armed
	add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_dirty = 1 }
}

TPMP_SOV_dy_weekly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SOV NOT = { has_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_dy_delivered } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { date < 1936.2.1 } }
			TPMP_SOV_dy_preset_oldpile = yes
			TPMP_SOV_dy_deliver = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { date < 1937.1.1 } }
			TPMP_SOV_dy_display = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_dy_total = 0 } }
				TPMP_SOV_dy_preset_oldpile = yes
			}
			TPMP_SOV_dy_deliver = yes
		}
	}
}

TPMP_SOV_dy_export = {
	print_variables = {
		file = TPMP_SOV_defence_order
		text = TPMP_SOV_dy_export_header
		append = yes
		print_global = no
		var_list = { TPMP_SOV_dy_s_lt36 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_lt38 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_mt36 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_mt38 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_ht36 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_sp1 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_mp1 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_lp1 TPMP_SOV_dy_s_li TPMP_SOV_dy_s_mi TPMP_SOV_dy_s_si TPMP_SOV_dy_s_sup TPMP_SOV_dy_s_art TPMP_SOV_dy_s_at TPMP_SOV_dy_s_aa TPMP_SOV_dy_s_mot }
	}
	set_country_flag = { flag = TPMP_SOV_dy_exported days = 7 }
}
